name: image-preview
description: Shows pictures in the transcript: the ones you attach to a prompt and the ones any tool returns (Read, screenshots, MCP tools)

size.title: Picture size
size.description: How large a picture is drawn in the transcript. Several pictures on one row are drawn as smaller thumbnails side by side.

captions.title: Captions
captions.description: Show each picture's size in pixels and an open button under it.
